meta.name: vibe-prd
meta.description: Create a Product Requirements Document (PRD) for your MVP. Use when the user wants to define product requirements, create a PRD, or says "help me write requirements", "create PRD", or "define my product".

copy.tagline: 把产品想法转化为结构化的需求文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构思产品功能，需要一份清晰的PRD来指导开发。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product ideas into structured requirement documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are defining product features and need a clear PRD to guide development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步填写产品需求，最终生成一份完整的 PRD 文档，并保存到项目文件夹中。
howto.when: 当你提到“帮我写需求”、“创建 PRD”或“定义我的产品”时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份产品需求文档。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问，收集产品信息。

say.text: 我要为我的 MVP 创建 PRD。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成需求定义。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you step by step to fill in product requirements and finally generate a complete PRD document, saving it to the project folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "help me write requirements", "create PRD", or "define my product".

say_en.text: Help me write a product requirements document.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions to gather product info.

say_en.text: I want to create a PRD for my MVP.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through defining requirements.
